messages:
Sam: quick async standup — what I did: ran the nightly kernel latency sweep against the batching branch, measured tail p95 improvements (~8-12% depending on seq_len). pushed micro-optim that reduces small-batch headroom.
Maya: nice. any diffs on memory / kv residency? :eyes:
Sam: memory stable for 512/1024 lengths. KV hit rate dropped ~0.5% on cold start because of slight slot reshuffle; warm steady state is unchanged. attached small snippet from the bench below.
Priya: can you paste the command you ran? I want to reproduce locally.
Sam: sure — `./bench/run_latency.py --suite=kernel_batching --iters=200 --model=m30 --seq-lens=128,512,1024 --warmup=50`.
Alex: thx. also saw a flaky test in `kv_cache_test` on CI this morning, looks related to eviction timing.
Jordan: @Alex which CI job? I can take a look after standup.
Alex: `eng-runtime-ci/kv-smoke/3` — failure in `TestEvictRace` once, timing window.
Maya: FYI I left a small comment on Sam's PR (#4128) about making the prefetch heuristic opt-in for now. If we flip it global it may affect some enterprise workloads.
Sam: noted — I'll add an arg flag `--prefetch=auto|on|off` and default to `auto`. Will push update by EOD.
Priya: blocker: I can't repro the full p95 drop locally, my harness shows noise. Could be due to different CPU affinity on CI machines.
Sam: that makes sense. try `taskset -c 2-5` and set `RUNTIME_THREADS=8` in env; benches on CI use pinned layout.
Priya: will do.
Jordan: quick ask — can someone review my microbatch slot allocator PR? It's been open 18h, two small nits left. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/4192
Maya: I'll take a pass in the afternoon.
deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly canary deploy scheduled at 23:00 UTC. If any of you plan hotfixes, please merge before 21:30 UTC or opt out using the canary exclude tag.
Sam: FYI I'll opt the batching branch out until the eviction timing test is addressed.
Alex: I'll triage the eviction test today and dump a minimal repro for the team.
Priya: today: repro + run benches with pinned affinity, then sync with Sam and Alex. Blocker: flaky eviction test.
Maya: today: review Jordan's allocator PR, verify prefetch flag switch won't break Dedicated workloads.
Sam: thanks team. ping me on Slack if you need the bench artifacts — I uploaded logs to /mnt/benchlogs/1732123456. :thumbsup:
